items.t: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning Equinix Stock In The Last 15 Years
items.sum: Equinix (NASDAQ:EQIX) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 4.22% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 17.17%. Currently, Equinix has a market capitalization of $105.73 billion.

items.t: Is Equinix (EQIX) Reasonable With Cash Flow Riding On Expansion?

items.sum: Equinix issued €2.5b of green senior notes across four euro tranches and opened its SG6 AI-ready data center in Singapore, while extending AI security partnerships and appointing a new Malaysia head. items.t: Equinix (EQIX) Lands First Silicon Spin Quantum Computer And €2.5 Billion Green Bond
items.sum: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) has hosted Diraq's world-first silicon spin quantum computer inside one of its data centers, marking an early commercial deployment alongside traditional infrastructure. The Diraq system uses silicon spin qubits that are designed to be compatible with existing semiconductor processes, targeting more efficient scaling within Equinix facilities. items.t: Equinix Has Negative Free Cash Flow. So How Is Its Dividend Still Covered?
items.sum: Billions in capex push Equinix's free cash flow below zero, and its earnings multiple looks stretched. Yet one overlooked metric tells a very different story about the dividend, and a rising debt pile could still threaten it.

items.t: Equinix Issues €2.5 Billion in Green Bonds to Advance Sustainability Initiatives
items.sum: Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company®, today announced that Equinix Europe 2 Financing Corporation LLC has issued €2.5 billion in aggregate principal amount of green senior notes across four tranches, which carry an effective all-in interest rate of 4.82% per year on a blended basis after the estimated impact of interest rate hedges.
